title: Slice-tail test batching: cap on existing-green, author tests once per slice, never close red
action: Implement spec #80/#85 P1, P2, P4, P5. P3 is a restatement: bugfix repro-first is unchanged and must be shown unchanged. (P1) packages/bee/lib/cells.mjs: add proof tier 'existing-targeted-green' and amend requiredProofTier at line 124 so change_class behavior or api on lanes tiny, small, standard resolves to it instead of 'targeted-green'. bugfix keeps 'targeted-green' with repro-first; security and migration keep 'red-first'; refactor and formatting keep 'suite-green'; high-risk keeps 'red-first' for behavior-bearing classes. 'existing-targeted-green' means capCell accepts the cell's targeted scope of the EXISTING suite green with no new-test authoring obligation; the cell verify field stays a runnable command recorded with output and the cap still proves the cell did not break what exists. (P2) Add 'test' to CHANGE_CLASSES at line 89 as the slice test cell class; its proof tier is 'targeted-green'. (P4) THE LOAD-BEARING PART: a feature cannot leave phase swarming while any cell of the active feature with change_class 'test' is uncapped, or is capped with a failing recorded verify. Enforce as a THROW in the phase-transition path in packages/bee/bee.mjs, same style as the AO3 advisor-consult throw on the execution gate. Not a warning. NOT liftable by headless or by any gate_bypass level including total, because it is a mechanical precondition and not a human gate. Implementer note: there is NO slice record anywhere in this codebase; slices exist only in skill text. Do not invent a slice entity. Scope the block to the active feature's test-class cells, which is the machine-checkable expression of the spec intent. (P5) The done-report contract in skills/bee-swarming gains a 'Test consolidation' line: number of behavior cells, test cell id, suite result. (SKILLS) Update the proof-tier matrix in skills/bee-executing/SKILL.md, and skills/bee-planning/SKILL.md so planning emits exactly one trailing test cell per slice whenever the slice holds at least one behavior or api cell, depending on all implementation cells of that slice; test-economy D3 ratio ceilings compute against the slice aggregate source delta, not per cell; D5 read-first applies at the test cell. Keep skill text thin: these skills are already over-weight per spec 78.

truths: requiredProofTier returns 'existing-targeted-green' for behavior and api on tiny, small and standard, and is unchanged for every other matrix row including bugfix, security, migration, refactor, formatting and every high-risk row.
capCell accepts a behavior-class cell on those lanes with existing-suite-green evidence and no newly authored test, and still refuses when the recorded verify is failing or absent.

Leaving phase swarming throws while the active feature has an uncapped test-class cell or a test-class cell whose recorded verify failed; the throw fires under headless and under every gate_bypass level including total.
bugfix repro-first behavior is provably unchanged - demonstrate it, since over-reading the amendment is the whole risk.
Existing tests covering requiredProofTier and capCell are updated only where the matrix genuinely changed; no test is deleted or weakened to pass.
The vendored .bee/bin copies carry the change and ledger parity passes.
prohibitions: Do NOT invent a slice record, slice id, or slice state file.
Do NOT let any bypass level or headless mode lift the red block.
Do NOT touch CI-owned full verify, the verify-red flow, or the no-test-repo sentinel.
Do NOT weaken test-economy D3 new_suite_reason or D5 read-first.
Do NOT change gate semantics or bypass levels.

verify: node scripts/ledger_parity.mjs --check && node scripts/release_manifest.mjs --check && node scripts/run_verify.mjs

trace.outcome: Slice-tail test batching lands: behavior/api outside high-risk now cap on 'existing-targeted-green' (no new-test authoring at the cell), a 'test' change_class carries the slice's consolidated authoring at 'targeted-green', and leaving phase swarming with an uncapped or red test cell is a CLI throw at BOTH doors (state set --phase and state scribing-run) that no gate_bypass level or headless run lifts. bugfix keeps repro-first, pinned by its own branch plus a dedicated negative control.

# fs-1 — Slice-tail test batching (spec #80/#85 P1/P2/P4/P5)

Cell fs-1 · lane standard · change_class behavior · worker exec-fs1

## Proof-tier matrix — before → after

| change_class | lane | before | after |
|---|---|---|---|
| `security` / `migration` | every | `red-first` | `red-first` (unchanged) |
| `refactor` / `formatting` | every | `suite-green` | `suite-green` (unchanged) |
| `bugfix` | tiny/small/standard | `targeted-green` | **`targeted-green` (unchanged — repro-first survives)** |
| `bugfix` | high-risk | `red-first` | `red-first` (unchanged) |
| `behavior` / `api` | tiny/small/standard | `targeted-green` | **`existing-targeted-green`** (P1) |
| `behavior` / `api` | high-risk | `red-first` | `red-first` (unchanged) |
| `test` | every | *(not a class)* | **`targeted-green`** (P2) |
| unclassified | any | `null` | `null` (unchanged) |

## Probes

| probe | expected | got | pass |
|---|---|---|---|
| `requiredProofTier('behavior','standard')` | `existing-targeted-green` | same | yes |
| `requiredProofTier('bugfix', tiny/small/standard)` | `targeted-green` | same | yes |
| `requiredProofTier('bugfix','high-risk')` | `red-first` | same | yes |
| `requiredProofTier('test', every lane)` | `targeted-green` | same | yes |
| capCell behavior×standard, no new test, no `red_failure_evidence` | caps | caps | yes |
| capCell behavior×standard with no verify record | refuses | refuses | yes |
| capCell test-cell adding a new suite without `new_suite_reason` | refuses | refuses | yes |
| leave `swarming` with uncapped `test` cell | throws, state byte-identical | same | yes |
| same, with `gate_bypass: "total"` | still throws | still throws | yes |
| `test` cell capped with `verify_passed:false` | throws | throws | yes |
| `test` cell capped green | departure allowed | allowed | yes |
| uncapped `behavior` cell (not `test`) | no block | no block | yes |
| `scribing-run` out of swarming, red test cell | throws, nothing stamped | same | yes |

**bugfix unchanged:** `requiredProofTier` now handles `bugfix` in its **own branch**, textually separate from `behavior`/`api`, so the P1 edit could not sweep it along. Pinned twice: the table-driven matrix row and a dedicated negative-control check asserting `bugfix` is `targeted-green` (and explicitly **not** `existing-targeted-green`) on tiny/small/standard, `red-first` on high-risk.

## P4 wiring

`guardTestCellDebt(root, record, targetPhase)` in `packages/bee/bee.mjs` (co-located with `closeGuardScribingDebt`, same choke-point rationale — `checkPhaseTransition` must stay pure because `cells.mjs` imports `state.mjs`). Called from **both** doors out of `swarming`: `handleStateSet` (after `checkPhaseTransition`, before any field write, inside the mutation lock) and `handleStateScribingRun` (before the `last_scribing_run` stamp and the ledger append). Reads neither `bypassLevel` nor any headless flag, and has no waiver flag. Scope is the **active feature's** `change_class:'test'` cells — no slice record was invented, because none exists in this codebase.
